description:
kith-core/src/lib.rs defines make_attachment(), make_mention(), and make_broadcast_mention() by constructing a serde_json::json!({...}) Value and then calling serde_json::from_value() on it. The doc comments explain this is because jmap-chat-types marks these structs #[non_exhaustive] without providing constructor functions.

This is an imposed workaround for an upstream API gap, not a design choice. The pattern is inelegant (JSON serialization as a constructor, with a panic-on-failure expect) and the panic path, while labeled as 'logic error', is invisible to callers.

Two options:
1. Upstream: add pub fn new() constructors to Attachment, Mention, BroadcastMention in jmap-chat-types. This is the correct fix and removes the workaround entirely.
2. Local: document in the CLAUDE.md or architecture notes that these helpers exist specifically because of the upstream gap, with a pointer to the relevant issue or PR. This prevents future contributors from wondering why serialization is being used for construction.

The workaround is acknowledged implicitly ('this is a bug in kith-core if it fires'), but the root cause is not stated in the code.
title: make_attachment and make_mention construct types via serde round-trip
